system_thesis_interpretation: The exact composite v9 protocol is independently implementable as the same small controlled writer pilot defined by v7 and repaired by v8: execute one adapter-free four-task prefix once; seal and byte-clone one condition-free public snapshot into H and E; make the sleep-1 rank-16 q/v LoRA mount the only difference at the first post-fork call; continue the same four acquisition tasks under H without an adapter and E with its declared adapter; rebuild E once more from the clean base using only the cumulative eligible common-prefix and E-life immediate-improvement packet-to-action rows; and run four fixed syntactic targets under H, E_ON, and the same sealed final E state with the adapter absent. V9 changes no model, arm, task, target, training row, score, visibility edge, runtime behavior, or scientific product. Its sole systems change makes the already-normative one-manifest lifecycle directly falsifiable through exhaustive independent failure injection, one explicit manifest-bound transition table and execution order, and comparison of the actual ordered execution suffix against that table before release. The resulting evidence surface remains finite and constructible: immutable packets, events and commits; H/E snapshots; row, token, mask, update and finite-check telemetry; atomic adapter publications and mounts; twelve cold-cell receipts; lifecycle traces; and exact rational computations. No material implementability blocker remains in the proposed bytes. Canonical receipt encodings, concrete table serialization, stable implementation identifiers, commands, resource figures, and telemetry fields remain ordinary implementation artifacts to be frozen and hash-bound before T04, rather than missing cognitive architecture or an invitation to expand into OS security, exhaustive architecture-level schemas, duplicate training, or new science arms. These model-authored bytes authorize nothing by themselves.
graph_delta_interpretation: V6S9_LIFECYCLE_EVIDENCE closes the sole v8 evidence gap without changing the execution graph. The production controller and an independent fixture oracle must expose the same complete finite phase vocabulary: engineering canary; common-prefix reset, model, service, slot commit and task commit; sleep-1 selection, tokenization, training, publication and mount; the corresponding reset, model, service, slot-commit and task-commit boundaries for each H/E continuation; sleep-2 selection, tokenization, training, publication and mount; final snapshot and panel construction; and every ordered panel-cell position. An actual separately executable failure boundary cannot be hidden by renaming or coalescing evidence: it must appear in the T04 table and receive the applicable T01 ordinary- and integrity-class cases. V6S9_FAILURE_TO_STATUS makes the transition table, not a reconstructed terminal label, authoritative over release. Before panel entry, ordinary failure has only the terminal RUN_INCOMPLETE path and no later experimental command, model request, environment action, update, publication, mount, snapshot/panel work, cell, aggregate, or numeric report. After panel entry, only ordinary failure of the current frozen cell may seal that cell missing and advance once through each remaining cell in the prebound order to PANEL_INCOMPLETE; it may not retry, feed a result forward, or compute either D. Integrity failure at any point has precedence, stops all remaining work, produces INTEGRITY_FAILURE, and suppresses numeric values. A status is therefore supported only by the corresponding ordered command/event/commit/status trace, including the absence of every forbidden suffix. The target-data and report edges are otherwise unchanged: target evidence remains offline during execution, and only a successful T05 audit can open the status-permitted literal report path.
loop_delta_interpretation: The V6S9 lifecycle-test loop is a preflight-and-audit loop around the unchanged v7/v8 wake, writer, and panel loops. T01 independently exercises every registered phase boundary under ordinary and integrity failure. Its pre-panel cases must terminate the whole manifest, including an otherwise healthy H or E branch, and prove the forbidden execution suffix empty. Its ordinary panel cases must be position-sensitive: the failed cell is sealed missing, earlier cells are not repeated, every later cell in the frozen twelve-cell order executes exactly once, no prior or failed result becomes input, aggregates stay absent, and the terminal status is PANEL_INCOMPLETE. Its panel integrity cases stop immediately and release no number. T04 then binds a literal lifecycle table to the exact implementation and candidate run manifest. The table must give every named and implementation-real phase a unique success successor, ordinary-failure successor, and integrity-failure successor, and it must include the exact H/E continuation order and all twelve cell positions. Because an implicit or production-code-derived-only table is a veto, independent fixtures can be checked against an authority distinct from the controller they test. After separate run authorization, T05 replays the immutable actual command, event, commit and status order against that exact table. It checks transitions and the complete post-event suffix rather than accepting a plausible terminal status alone. Any missing, repeated, reordered, unexpected or forbidden operation, any ordinary continuation outside a post-entry cell failure, or any lifecycle/table binding mismatch is INTEGRITY_FAILURE with numeric suppression. This closes branch salvage, retry, resume, and silent continuation while preserving the one permitted missing-cell continuation and the proportional non-bitwise update audit inherited from v8.
claim_delta_interpretation: V9 adds no scientific conclusion. After a passing T05, the report may contain only the status and the exact raw curves, status-permitted completed cells, missing-cell map, reduced rational F values, and—only for a complete twelve-cell panel—the reduced rational D_HE and D_ONOFF values already allowed by v8. Signs or exact equality and literal action or registered-score inequality describe only this one audited manifest. RUN_INCOMPLETE and PANEL_INCOMPLETE are operational statuses rather than zeros; PANEL_INCOMPLETE has no D aggregates; INTEGRITY_FAILURE releases no numeric value. The new lifecycle condition is evidentiary: even arithmetically correct values remain quarantined unless the actual trace has the sole legal stop or continuation suffix. It does not turn lifecycle conformance into evidence of action-cloning sufficiency, efficacy, harm, mechanism, semantic generalization, transferable structure, continual learning, intelligent sleep, or a paper claim. Choosing a later sleeper assay remains a documented heuristic. No replicate, control writer, alternative task panel, threshold, inference procedure, or new scientific arm is required or authorized for this exact-run descriptive scope.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The exact three-information-item by five-stage matrix remains complete and consistent. CPU_FIXTURES_SEAL contains only independently authored synthetic packet, writer, mount and lifecycle fixtures plus the two narrowly authorized no-model reset/baseline sealer invocations; it contains no learned target action or result. COMMON_PREFIX exposes only canonical condition-free public packet state and forbids condition, adapter, training and target-result information. FORKED_ACQUISITION_SLEEP exposes branch-local public packets and the below-prompt behavioral effect of assigned weights, while condition labels, row membership, labels, optimizer state, telemetry, receipts and all target results remain offline. FINAL_PANEL gives each cold logical cell only its target-local packet from the assigned sealed snapshot; adapter/NONE assignment is below the prompt, and every target action and result stays offline and cannot influence a later cell, life, memory, writer, row, choice or tuning decision. POSTRUN_AUDIT is the first stage where the reviewer may jointly inspect public state, condition/training state, target receipts and the lifecycle trace. Adding table and suffix evidence does not create a new model-visible edge: phase IDs, failure injections, commands, events, commits, statuses and audit encodings remain control-plane evidence. The matrix supports finite application-level target-feedback exclusion and exact trace auditability, not machine-wide noninterference or an OS-security claim.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S9_T01_STATE_ACTION_LIFECYCLE_GOLDENS retains the independently authored v8 state/action/fork oracle and now literally adds the complete lifecycle matrix. It must preserve the canonical packet, parser, six-slot reducer, memory, atomic commit, score and exact-clone goldens; inject ordinary failure at the canary, every named common-prefix boundary, every sleep-1 boundary, every H and E continuation boundary, every sleep-2 boundary, and final snapshot/panel construction; and inject integrity failure at every lifecycle phase. Each pre-panel ordinary case must produce RUN_INCOMPLETE and prove no later model request, action, update, publication, mount, final-seal/panel operation, cell or numeric-report suffix. Each integrity case must stop immediately as INTEGRITY_FAILURE and suppress numbers. Separately, every final-cell position receives ordinary- and integrity-class injection: ordinary failure seals one missing cell, executes every remaining frozen cell once without retry or feedback, omits both D values and ends PANEL_INCOMPLETE; integrity failure stops the remaining panel and suppresses all numeric values. This is exact phase-and-suffix coverage, not status-only testing. V6S9_T02_SLEEP_SAMPLE_GOLDENS is unchanged substantively: an independent path must reconstruct event eligibility and packet hash checks, earliest-event deduplication, row-hash/copy-index order, literal tokenizer arrays and suffix-only masks, update indices and count, every q_proj/v_proj target, toy AdamW/clipping order, finite checks, atomic publication and mount failures without importing the production helpers under test. It proves support and scheduling for the declared writer, not GPU numerical reproducibility or efficacy. V6S9_T03_DOUBLE_SEAL is unchanged substantively: exactly two fresh CPU/no-model invocations of the frozen algorithm over unchanged local CompilerGym bytes must yield byte-identical ordered eight-acquisition/four-target manifests, twelve unique URI bytes and bitcode hashes, exact repeated Autophase/I0/IOz, eligibility/rejection provenance, and no model action, learned target result, Fable input, tuning, retry, substitution or third sealer. It establishes reproducible target-blind syntactic selection only. V6S9_T04_PRE_GPU_REVIEW is the authoritative constructibility and feasibility veto. A fresh reviewer and non-overriding advocate inspect the exact composite v9 hashes, implementation and command, T01--T03 evidence and independent provenance, frozen audit/telemetry schemas, immutable manifest, finite data paths, maximum-length canary and quantitative 7B GH200 budget. In addition, one explicit table must be hash-bound to the exact production controller and manifest, enumerate all named and actual phases with their sole success/ordinary/integrity transitions, bind the exact H/E branch and twelve-cell order, and be shown to govern both production and exhaustive T01 cases. An implicit, incomplete or code-derived-only table is a veto. Approval authorizes no run; it only permits the one exact candidate manifest to be presented once for Rohin's separate ratification. V6S9_T05_POSTRUN_AUDIT remains the sole status/value release gate. A new reviewer reconstructs every actual packet, parse, action, state, memory, row, token, mask, update index/count/configuration, finite check, publication, tensor inventory, mount, snapshot, cell, exact rational score, aggregate availability and status from immutable evidence without floating-point retraining. It also compares the complete ordered actual command/event/commit/status trace to the exact T04 table and order, verifying the sole legal boundary and absence of a forbidden suffix. Any lifecycle mismatch, target feedback or provenance mismatch is INTEGRITY_FAILURE with numeric suppression. Together the five tests now exactly cover state/fork semantics, writer construction, syntactic environment sealing, pre-run constructibility and authority, actual-run provenance, lifecycle legality and the narrow release claim without adding a test, experiment or science arm.
assumptions: The operative protocol is the exact v7 base at SHA-256 6ddec2537cabcd4228a1d3144988f3483ba1e86ecc6be85fe5c82301449836b1, plus the exact v8 amendments at SHA-256 f4659794db70e2c31a8837148e241711c776c1a7cca86784d87fdc729964abd0, plus only the v9 acceptance-test amendment at SHA-256 7332fb331784a46593ab537cd195cf7890c4840f97b6c7f513959df84968f278; later clauses supersede only direct conflicts.

The V6S9 namespace is a one-for-one successor namespace for the five retained logical tests, not permission to accept stale V6S8 evidence or to add a sixth test; every v9 receipt and review binding must identify the V6S9 test and exact v9 composite bytes.

The explicitly listed T01 phases are mandatory minimum rows. Any additional separately executable implementation phase that can succeed or fail before release is also represented in the T04 table and receives the applicable independent ordinary- and integrity-failure injection rather than being omitted behind the phrase 'represented by the implementation'.

Final-panel entry occurs only after successful final snapshot sealing and panel construction. Failure during either of those named boundaries is pre-panel RUN_INCOMPLETE; the ordinary-failure continuation exception begins only with entry into a frozen ordered cell.

An empty forbidden execution suffix permits only the terminal status, immutable failure evidence and later independent audit operations authorized by the T04 table; it permits no further experimental model, environment, training, publication, mount, snapshot, panel or reporting work.

The T04 lifecycle table is a standalone canonical artifact bound by hash in the exact candidate run manifest and review bundle. Production control flow may implement it, but production code cannot be the sole source from which its expected transitions or T01 expectations are derived.

The exact H/E branch order covers every acquisition continuation and sleep boundary, and the twelve-cell order identifies every condition-target position. The actual trace uses stable identities sufficient for T05 to detect an omission, duplication, reordering, retry or unregistered branch.

Canonical audit encodings, minimal per-update telemetry, table serialization, implementation and environment identities, commands, seeds, dtype, initialization, gradient-checkpointing, hardware, paths and quantitative budget are frozen before T04 and cannot change between review, separate human run ratification and execution.

A completed T05 audit may verify and release the appropriate registered ordinary-failure status with only its status-permitted evidence, while an integrity mismatch permits the verified INTEGRITY_FAILURE status but no numeric value.
Passing tests, this interpretation, a consensus recommendation or an advocate statement cannot supply architecture or run authority; only the separately recorded exact human ratifications can do so.
